done_when: Every review and plan read records its model, effort, chat id and token use in Forge's run records, the same way worker rounds do

findings.body: Raise: Test. The `existing_repo` proof upgrades a repo adopted on an earlier release, but then checks only a `work` run end. It never runs a plan read or asserts the review run's model, effort, chat id, and token use. This test would pass if either new cost-recording path failed after upgrade, so the proof list's upgrade claim remains untested.
findings.title: Not done: earlier-adopted repo review and plan-read cost test

why: Reviews and plan reads record no model, effort, chat or token use, so nobody can tell what they cost or whether a lighter setting would do
